key_insight: An explicit block-encoding of the shifted finite element stiffness matrix enables a resource-efficient quantum framework for 2D isotropic linear elasticity.
engineering_relevance: The framework identifies conditions for polynomial quantum speedups in preparing displacement states, estimating strain energy, and reconstructing low-resolution displacements.
method: Analytically diagonalize element stiffness matrices and factorize global finite element assembly.
Construct normalized block-encoding with constant ancilla qubits and gate complexity logarithmic in the degrees of freedom.
Apply a quantum singular value transformation-based linear system solver.
evidence_signal: Numerical cantilever beam experiments verify circuit accuracy and show agreement with conventional finite element solutions.
watch_item: Speedups are conditional and task-specific; low-resolution displacement reconstruction does not establish efficient recovery of the full classical solution.
paper_title: Quantum algorithmic framework for finite element analysis of isotropic linear elastic materials via efficient block-encoding
